request.style: English, female mezzo-soprano solo with ethereal choir, harp, piano, cello, strings, ambient pads, somber and mysterious, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Beside the Ulai Canal I stood
A ram with two long horns appeared
One horn was higher than the rest
It charged west, north, and south
No animal could stand against its power
It did as it pleased and grew great

[Pre-Chorus]
Then a male goat came from the west
Crossing the earth without touching ground
A conspicuous horn between its eyes
It rushed at the ram in furious power

[Chorus]
The large horn is broken off
Four horns grow toward the four winds of heaven
Out of one comes a small horn
Growing exceedingly great toward the south

[Verse]
It reaches the host of heaven
Throwing stars down to the earth to be trampled
It sets itself up against the Prince
Taking away the daily sacrifice

[Pre-Chorus]
Truth is flung to the ground
Whatever it does, it prospered
I heard a holy one speaking
Asking how long this desolation will last

[Chorus]
The large horn is broken off
Four horns grow toward the four winds of heaven
Out of one comes a small horn
Growing exceedingly great toward the south

[Verse]
Gabriel explains the vision to me
The ram represents Media and Persia
The goat is the king of Greece
The large horn is the first king

[Pre-Chorus]
Four kingdoms will arise from his nation
But they will not have his power
A fierce-looking king will arise
A master of intrigue and cunning

[Chorus]
The large horn is broken off
Four horns grow toward the four winds of heaven
Out of one comes a small horn
Growing exceedingly great toward the south

[Bridge]
He will destroy the mighty and the holy people
Through his cunning, deceit will prosper
He will exalt himself in his heart
But he will be broken, not by human hand

[Outro]
It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings
Then the sanctuary will be restored to its rightful state
